signal: GoFreight, the freight-forwarding software platform, now serves over 1,000 forwarders with customers seeing average 98% revenue increases, navigating a 2026 market recalibration as inflated freight rates fade

email.body1:
Alex, saw GoFreight pass 1,000 forwarders with customers reporting average 98 percent revenue gains, even as 2026 forces the market to recalibrate.

In a year of recalibration, more forwarders fit your ICP than the team can work, and good-fit accounts go cold before a rep reaches them. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for GoFreight off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Alex, quick follow-up for GoFreight.

With easy freight-rate revenue gone, every rep hour has to count, and reps end up buried in research and CRM work instead of selling. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap shows up late.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings GoFreight needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Alex, last bit of proof for GoFreight.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how GoFreight's reply rate likely compares to other logistics-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Alex, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Timing matters in a recalibrating market, and running sales as a co-founder keeps the calendar full.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your forwarding motion? I'll tailor it to GoFreight either way.
